Name: Diverse Stardew Valley x Nyapu's Portraits
Author: AirynS
AuthorLabel: Nyapu Airyn and the DSV Team
Description:
[center][b][size=5]﻿﻿Diverse Stardew Valley x Nyapu's Portraits﻿[/size][size=4]
[/size][/b][/center]
[size=3]This mod adapts [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits [/url]﻿to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]'s alternate character designs! It contains only portraits; the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17063]non-seasonal[/url] version of DSV is required for character sprites as well as additional features such as dialogue, map edits, and gift taste changes. This is a non-seasonal portrait pack.

Big thanks to Nyapu for allowing us to create these edits of their original portraits and for creating Marigold's portrait! Please make sure to endorse their mod.[/size]


[size=3][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/0R7biKQ.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]This mod requires [size=3][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/470174-content-patcher]Content Patcher[/url][/size][/size][/size] and the SMAPI modding framework; if you have not installed SMAPI before, see the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]Stardew Valley Wiki's guide[/url] for instructions.

It also requires:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url][/size][/size]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17063]Diverse Stardew Valley - Non-Seasonal[/url]
[/size]
[size=3][size=3]
[img]https://imgur.com/v0kYolw.png[/img]﻿

[size=3]In order to use this mod, you will need to configure DSV Non-Seasonal [/size][/size][/size][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3]via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] to [/size][/size][/size]use the character variants you would like, and [size=3][size=3][size=3]thanks to DSV Core's C# tokens, DSV x Nyapu will automatically match your configuration options![/size][/size][/size] [size=3][size=3][size=3] For any characters that you would prefer to use their vanilla design, set them to "vanilla" or "off" in the configuration options. This will allow Nyapu's original portrait to take priority.[/size][/size][/size]

Please refer to the [url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com/index.html]Diverse Stardew Valley website[/url] and the screenshots for a visual guide to the various options available.[/size][/size][/size][size=3]


[img]https://imgur.com/EirFN0t.png[/img]﻿

For compatibility questions, please refer to the [url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com/compatibility.html]Compatible Mods [/url]page of the DSV website. Please note that [b]not all compatibility options are available in this mod.[/b][/size][b]
[/b][size=3]
This pack is automatically compatible with Nyapu's Ridgeside Village and Adventurer's Guild Expanded portrait packs, as well as Zilchaz's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20237]Nyapu-Style's Clara[/url]![/size]

[size=3][b]Note: Diverse Stardew Valley is partially incompatible with Stardew Valley Expanded and some characters will automatically be turned off if SVE is installed. SVE compatibility will not be added. For more details, see the SVE section on the Compatibility page.


[/b]Thanks to skellady for adapting some of the original DSV x Nyapu portraits, to Prerona for adapting some of the winter Nyapu portraits, and to Kedi and Rikai for updating the code to match DSV Non-Seasonal 6.0.0 <3[/size]
